newsitem.title: USA: Utah Hunter 2 coal power plant restart seen today.
newsitem.headline: Utah Hunter 2 coal power plant restart seen today.

text.p: The 415 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Hunter coal-fired power plant in Castle Dale, Utah, is expected to begin restarting Thursday afternoon, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Thursday morning.
The unit, which has been down since Saturday for unplanned maintenance, is then expected to take six to eight hours to return to full capacity.
The Hunter plant, operated by PacifiCorp, also has a 420 MW unit 1 and a 440 MW unit 3.
PacifiCorp's ownership interest in unit 2 represents 270 MW of its capacity.
